tokens.name: og-bg
tokens.usage: Page background, set by OratgeRoot; BottomNav background; text on an active tab or chip.

tokens.name: og-night
tokens.usage: Night shading in hour and multi-day charts.

tokens.name: og-surface
tokens.usage: Cards: Card, og-card, FactTile, inactive tabs and chips. Same tint as og-bg, one step lighter.

tokens.name: og-surface-2
tokens.usage: Nested or raised surfaces inside a card (og-card og-raised).

tokens.name: og-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, nav border, pill borders, chart ticks and hatching. Decorative only.

tokens.name: og-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on og-bg, og-surface and og-surface-2: dark ≥13.01:1, light ≥13.69:1.

tokens.name: og-text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: muted copy, chips, legends on og-bg, og-surface and og-surface-2: dark ≥7.51:1, light ≥7.01:1.

tokens.name: og-text-3
tokens.usage: Faint text: labels, inactive nav, footnotes on og-bg, og-surface and og-surface-2: dark ≥4.52:1, light ≥4.53:1.

tokens.name: og-cloud
tokens.usage: Neutral cloud and moon tone in weather glyphs.

tokens.name: og-sand
tokens.usage: Dashed shoreline in WindCompass.

tokens.name: og-wind
tokens.usage: Wind only: wind lines, arrows, tailwind, the sea side of WindCompass. Same hue in both themes, a lighter step in dark: ≥6.5:1 on dark surfaces, ≥3.2:1 on light. Use it for lines, marks, icons and large values (20px+ semibold), never small text.

tokens.name: og-heat
tokens.usage: Heat and temperature only: temperature lines, headwind. Same hue in both themes, a lighter step in dark: ≥6.5:1 on dark surfaces, ≥3.2:1 on light. Use it for lines, marks, icons and large values (20px+ semibold), never small text.

tokens.name: og-water
tokens.usage: Water only: rain, waves, swell. Same hue in both themes, a lighter step in dark: ≥6.5:1 on dark surfaces, ≥3.2:1 on light. Use it for lines, marks, icons and large values (20px+ semibold), never small text.

tokens.name: og-sun
tokens.usage: Sun and UV only. Same hue in both themes, a lighter step in dark: ≥6.5:1 on dark surfaces, ≥3.2:1 on light. Use it for lines, marks, icons and large values (20px+ semibold), never small text.

tokens.name: og-storm
tokens.usage: Storm and lightning only. Same hue in both themes, a lighter step in dark: ≥6.5:1 on dark surfaces, ≥3.8:1 on light. Use it for lines, marks, icons and large values (20px+ semibold), never small text.

tokens.name: og-snow
tokens.usage: Snow and cold only. Same hue in both themes, a lighter step in dark: ≥8.0:1 on dark surfaces, ≥3.2:1 on light. Use it for lines, marks, icons and large values (20px+ semibold), never small text.

tokens.name: og-r0
tokens.usage: Rating 0: an empty rating cell or dot.

tokens.name: og-r1
tokens.usage: Rating 1 on the green ramp; in dark it brightens with the rating, in light it saturates. Always shown with the dot count (RatingDots, RatingStrip, HourChart rating row). Dark ≥3.3:1, light ≥3.2:1.

tokens.name: og-r2
tokens.usage: Rating 2 on the green ramp. Dark ≥4.6:1, light ≥3.2:1.

tokens.name: og-r3
tokens.usage: Rating 3 on the green ramp. Dark ≥6.3:1, light ≥3.2:1.

tokens.name: og-r4
tokens.usage: Rating 4 on the green ramp. Dark ≥8.4:1, light ≥3.2:1.

tokens.name: og-r5
tokens.usage: Rating 5 on the green ramp. Dark ≥10.5:1, light ≥3.2:1.

tokens.name: og-wind-1
tokens.usage: Wind speed band under 8 kn. Used by SpotCard and wind cells; brighter step in dark.

tokens.name: og-wind-2
tokens.usage: Wind speed 8–11 kn. Used by SpotCard and wind cells; brighter step in dark.

tokens.name: og-wind-3
tokens.usage: Wind speed 11–14 kn. Used by SpotCard and wind cells; brighter step in dark.

tokens.name: og-wind-4
tokens.usage: Wind speed 14–17 kn. Used by SpotCard and wind cells; brighter step in dark.

tokens.name: og-wind-5
tokens.usage: Wind speed 17 kn and above. Used by SpotCard and wind cells; brighter step in dark.

tokens.name: og-warn-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow Meteocat warning: reserved for WarningBanner and map warning areas. Same hue in both themes, lighter in dark: ≥6.5:1 dark, ≥3.2:1 light; always paired with the level word.

tokens.name: og-warn-orange
tokens.usage: Orange Meteocat warning: reserved for WarningBanner and map warning areas. Same hue in both themes, lighter in dark: ≥6.5:1 dark, ≥3.2:1 light; always paired with the level word.

tokens.name: og-warn-red
tokens.usage: Red Meteocat warning: reserved for WarningBanner and map warning areas. Same hue in both themes, lighter in dark: ≥6.5:1 dark, ≥3.2:1 light; always paired with the level word.

styles.name: fact-value-lg
styles.usage: Key numbers: FactTile size="lg", one strip per screen, coloured by the quantity they measure.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base text set by OratgeRoot, with tabular figures.

styles.name: act-window
styles.usage: Time window in ActivityRow; WarningBanner title uses the same size and weight.

styles.name: verdict-summary
styles.usage: Reasoning under the verdict in VerdictCard.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: ChipGroup chips (600 when active); WarningBanner detail.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: SectionLabel and FactTile labels (set in uppercase).

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Weekday under the date in DayTabs.

tokens.name: og-space-1
tokens.usage: Step of the source's 4–24px spacing scale (4px); not referenced by the component stylesheet.

tokens.name: og-space-2
tokens.usage: Step of the source's 4–24px spacing scale (8px); not referenced by the component stylesheet.

tokens.name: og-space-3
tokens.usage: Tight card padding (og-card og-tight).

tokens.name: og-space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding (og-card).

tokens.name: og-space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of a padded OratgeRoot (screen gutter).

tokens.name: og-space-6
tokens.usage: Step of the source's 4–24px spacing scale (24px); not referenced by the component stylesheet.

tokens.name: og-radius
tokens.usage: Cards (Card, og-card): rounded surfaces, no shadow.

tokens.name: og-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Smaller radius declared by the source; not referenced by the component stylesheet.
